title: Offer (v0)
description: A supply-stance posting or response. Same three-tier discipline as Intent: grouping_keys place it in a partition; capacity/price are the terms; category_ext carries the category shape (e.g. the route waypoints for intercity travel).

grouping_keys.description: Same coarse grouping keys as Intent (§P3), so supply and demand land in the same partition to be matched.

current.description: Per-unit price. Providers set price independently; they may NOT coordinate (§P1).

category_ext.description: Category-specific fields (intercity: ordered route waypoints). Validated against the category's offer-ext schema.

hold_expires_at.description: Perishability boundary. A hold on this capacity is void after this instant (prevents double-booking, docs/technical-deep-dive/01 §3).

requires_explicit_approval.description: If false (default), posting this offer IS the provider's blanket approval for any matching demand — a staged match_proposal auto-approves on the provider side. A higher-stakes category can set true to require per-match confirmation (docs/spec/01 §P11).

provider_stake.description: Optional per-match deposit the provider also puts up (§P11: "each party putting money"). Category-defined; most categories omit this.
